DIS.basis: Team scenario for FY2027 adjusted EPS: FY2025 actual 5.93 x 1.12 FY2026 growth excluding the extra week x 1.10 FY2027 growth. Company guides approximately 12% and double-digit growth respectively; 10% is our conservative interpretation, not a dollar EPS forecast from Disney.
DIS.reason: Judgemental 18x normalized forward earnings for a recovering diversified franchise. Peer businesses are heterogeneous, so no unadjusted peer-average valuation is claimed.
DIS.catalyst: November 17 FY2026 results and FY2027 outlook; streaming profitability, parks demand and cash conversion must support the normalization

selection_reason: Choose the six-stock basket with an economically negligible loss of full-residual IR versus the pure five-stock maximum, higher course Fundamental-Law IR, lower current tracking error, lower monthly TE and lower concentration. No alpha,valuation or stock-proportion rule was changed.

selection_decision.rule: Choose the six-stock basket with an economically negligible loss of full-residual IR versus the pure five-stock maximum, higher course Fundamental-Law IR, lower current tracking error, lower monthly TE and lower concentration. No alpha,valuation or stock-proportion rule was changed.
selection_decision.concentration_exception: Largest stock8.10%is slightly above the discretionary8%preference. Do not cap it manually and break the required alpha/residual-variance proportions. It is below the pure maximum basket9.09%concentration.
selection_decision.claim_limit: This is a documented risk-and-concentration choice near the residual-IR maximum,not the exact full-residual argmax or a global optimum.

funding_reason: Two-thirds of every original SAA ETF target. This is the original proposed class-notebook construction, not a new rule. It preserves relative ETF proportions and avoids an extra discretionary ETF funding bet.
risk_exception: Recent dailyTE remains above5%; that is an additional research preference,not the checkpoint rule. Show current-risk-adjusted expected activeIR and cost sensitivity rather than mislabel a daily pass.
objective: Expected course information ratio; official diagonal formula and full residual covariance robustness shown separately. Realized historicalIR is diagnostic, not used as a forecastalpha.
historical_status: Previously examined and reused development history;fixed-exposure replay,not a point-in-time discretionary stock-selection backtest.
